name: CyberAlchemy v2 and DomainSpec v2 PythonConstraint Whole Experiment
purpose: Test whether CyberAlchemy product meaning and DomainSpec-v2 typed intent can guide, run, and explain one complete formal software-engineering experiment without losing evidence, ownership, or claim boundaries.
scope: DomainSpec-v2 mapping of the selected PythonConstraint benchmark
the complete declared local experiment path
exact input, run, validation, and result evidence
a bounded assessment of what the result supports about the product thesis
exclusions: general proof that CyberAlchemy improves all agentic engineering
automatic promotion of DomainSpec-v2 or product ontology claims
automatic execution of successor benchmark tasks

evidence_index.supports: The owner selected PythonConstraint and pinned the Vero and source repository revisions.
evidence_index.claim_limit: Does not prove mapping, execution, validation, or product value.
